===Types===
{{Main|Impling#Implings}}
Almost all of the implings that players can catch using the Hunter skill can be encountered within the wheat maze while participating in Impetuous Impulses. The sole exception is the [[crystal impling]], which may only be caught within the walls of [[Prifddinas]].
